proposed_rules.trigger: A '2x1' zone with 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA text plus a '| |' separator at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as the site-wide footer fragment, excluded from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical across every captured page = global chrome, analogous to knack-announcement-bar. Rejected: per-page footer block (duplicates identical content everywhere).

proposed_rules.trigger: An FAQ [region] answer appears as a top-level page sibling instead of nested under its question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold back into the accordion block as the answer for its question.
proposed_rules.rationale: Artifact of overlay-promotion logic lifting elements rendered outside their DOM parent bounds.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [tablist] filter row (e.g. 'All Operations Clinical Support...') sits directly above a large [NxM] card grid, letting the visitor filter cards by category.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit ONE 'tabs' block with the tab labels as the header row and each card as a row tagged with its category; client JS filters visually. Rejected: modeling tabs and grid as two independent blocks (would break the filter wiring).
proposed_rules.rationale: The tablist and grid are functionally one interactive component; splitting them loses the filter relationship.
